description: Versioned scenario contracts implemented by Acta Bench. A catalogue entry alone never establishes successful execution or measurement.

cases.name: No-op end-to-end
cases.workload: Open-loop individually submitted no-op roots; terminal state durably observed.
safety_invariants: Each accepted logical identity reconciles to one permitted terminal result.
No successful root is counted before durable completion observation.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Single-call admission
cases.workload: Workers are paused; each call admits one logical job.
safety_invariants: Acknowledged identities remain after reconnect/restart.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Batch admission
cases.workload: Submit batches of 1, 100 and 1000; record partial/atomic outcomes according to contract.
safety_invariants: Batch outcomes match the declared atomicity and deduplication contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Preloaded backlog drain
cases.workload: Preload roots outside the measured window, then release workers.
safety_invariants: Every preloaded root reaches a permitted outcome; duplicates do not inflate throughput.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Three persisted steps
cases.workload: A root executes three named durable steps with deterministic results.
safety_invariants: All three committed results match expected values and order.
Root result matches its three-step aggregate.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Checkpoint-depth sweep
cases.workload: Repeat a fixed deterministic computation across 1, 10 and 100 durable steps.
safety_invariants: No missing or substituted step results.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Crash after checkpoint commit
cases.workload: Confirm step 2 committed, kill worker, resume the same root.
safety_invariants: Committed step results are reused under the declared checkpoint contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Crash after effect before checkpoint
cases.workload: The external sink commits an effect; hold handler before checkpoint and kill it.
safety_invariants: Engine recovery satisfies its at-least-once contract.
Retries and business applications are counted separately.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: At-most-once uncertain outcome
cases.workload: Crash after intent is stored and around external operation execution.
safety_invariants: No automatic second operation attempt when forbidden by the selected at-most-once contract.
Zero-or-one execution with uncertainty is not falsely labelled successful.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Ten children and join
cases.workload: One root creates ten children and checks a deterministic aggregate.
safety_invariants: Exactly the expected child key set exists.
Successful root follows all required successful child results.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Wide bounded fan-out
cases.workload: One root creates 1000 children using a declared maximum in-flight window.
safety_invariants: Window bound follows the declared contract.
No children disappear or change identity.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Nested tree
cases.workload: Five levels with fan-out 3 at each non-leaf node; publish exact graph size.
safety_invariants: All graph edges and leaf-derived aggregates match the independent model.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Parent dies during fan-out
cases.workload: Kill the parent worker after only part of the children have durably been created.
safety_invariants: Recovery produces the expected logical child set without forbidden duplicates.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Last-child join race
cases.workload: Coordinate the final child completion against parent wait registration.
safety_invariants: No lost wakeup; parent eventually observes all required results.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Partial failure policy
cases.workload: One child fails permanently and another is slow; use a named aggregation policy.
safety_invariants: Parent outcome follows the selected policy, not an assumed fail-fast rule.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Cancellation and descendants
cases.workload: Cancel a running parent and repeat around a worker crash.
safety_invariants: Durable cancellation and descendant convergence match the documented contract.
Physical external effects are not presumed cancelled by a control acknowledgement.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Cross-namespace children
cases.workload: A root joins children owned by another supported namespace.
safety_invariants: Child visibility and completion obey declared namespace semantics.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Durable timer resume
cases.workload: Park roots on timers, restart workers, and resume after due time.
safety_invariants: No early execution beyond configured clock tolerance.
Required timers eventually resume.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Signal before wait registration
cases.workload: Deliver a durably acknowledged signal before the relevant wait registration.
safety_invariants: No acknowledged signal is lost under the specified consumption/key contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Signal during wait registration

safety_invariants: No acknowledged signal is lost under the specified consumption/key contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Signal after wait registration

safety_invariants: No acknowledged signal is lost under the specified consumption/key contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Signal/timeout race
cases.workload: Deliver a signal at the timeout boundary in both causal orderings.
safety_invariants: Exactly one allowed resolution is chosen and retained.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Duplicate signal input
cases.workload: Send repeated logical signal inputs and multiple distinct signals.
safety_invariants: Observed consumption follows the declared deduplication/queueing semantics.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Transient failure and retry
cases.workload: A deterministic subset fails its first two attempts and then succeeds.
safety_invariants: No premature success.
Retry bounds and final outcomes match policy.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Poison job with healthy neighbours
cases.workload: A deterministic subset always fails; healthy roots continue.
safety_invariants: Poison roots terminate or park according to policy without invented success.
Healthy progress meets the declared liveness target.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Timeout and late attempt
cases.workload: An attempt times out while an external operation is still running.
safety_invariants: Late authoritative state changes obey ownership/version rules.
External overlap remains observable.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Many independent lanes
cases.workload: Route roots round-robin through 1000 keys.
safety_invariants: Per-key order follows the declared lane contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: One hot lane
cases.workload: All roots share one lane; include slow and retrying heads.
safety_invariants: Success/failure/advance behavior matches the declared lane policy.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Hot concurrency key
cases.workload: All roots contend on one key at the declared limit.
safety_invariants: Normal authoritative concurrency obeys the limit.
Stale physical execution is reported separately under the fault model.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Priority and tenant contention
cases.workload: Flood high-priority work while admitting lower-priority and other-tenant work.
safety_invariants: Scheduling follows the stated priority policy; starvation is reported, not prohibited unless promised.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Rate-meter windows
cases.workload: Drive a shared meter with multiple supported workers.
safety_invariants: Admissions satisfy the exact documented meter envelope, burst and reservation rules.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Kill a busy worker
cases.workload: Kill one worker with verified in-flight roots; survivors continue.
safety_invariants: Accepted work eventually reconciles after recovery.
required_evidence: Kill receipt, affected IDs and observed reclaim
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Kill all workers
cases.workload: Kill all run-owned workers; restart them against preserved state.
safety_invariants: Accepted work remains discoverable and resolves.
required_evidence: Before/after durable identity sets and restart evidence
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Pause beyond lease
cases.workload: Pause one worker beyond its lease and resume it after another reclaims.
safety_invariants: Stale attempts cannot make forbidden authoritative commits.
required_evidence: Old/new lease histories and state transitions
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Database disconnect
cases.workload: Interrupt worker/database connectivity while producers continue a bounded load.
safety_invariants: Ambiguous admissions and completions reconcile; no acknowledged obligation disappears.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Database-process crash
cases.workload: Hard-kill the owned database process and restart with the same durable volume.
safety_invariants: Acknowledged obligations survive within the specified process-crash durability contract.
required_evidence: Database crash/restart logs and volume identity
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Lost completion reply
cases.workload: Confirm a completion commits and drop its response to the worker.
safety_invariants: Recovery does not incorrectly duplicate terminal progression.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Lost enqueue reply
cases.workload: Confirm an enqueue commits, lose its response, then retry with the same logical key.
safety_invariants: Logical identity is reconciled without invented loss or forbidden duplicate admission.
required_evidence: Commit evidence and producer ambiguity ledger
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Optional wakeup transport unavailable
cases.workload: Disable an optional notification accelerator while durable storage remains healthy.
safety_invariants: Work still progresses under the documented fallback semantics.
required_evidence: Transport outage and fallback pickup history
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Crash-recovery certification under seeded kills
cases.workload: Seed stepped jobs, three rate meters, lanes, at-most-once charges, and outbox rows staged through the window; kill a worker every few seconds for the chaos window, whose first two leases are a warm-up before any reclaim is possible; quiesce, reconcile every job, and run the ledger checks.
safety_invariants: All accepted obligations reconcile under the bounded failure/recovery model.
required_evidence: At least the configured number of busy-worker kills with observed reclaim
An orphaned attempt in the ledger
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Retained-history sweep
cases.workload: Run equivalent work with clean, 100000-row and 1000000-row retained populations.
safety_invariants: Correctness is unaffected by unrelated retained records.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Parked-work skew
cases.workload: Execute due roots alongside 50000 legitimately suspended roots.
safety_invariants: Parked roots remain intact and due roots make progress.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Future high-priority skew
cases.workload: Due ordinary roots compete with 200000 high-priority roots due in the future.
safety_invariants: Not-yet-due work does not execute early; due work progresses.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Retention during load
cases.workload: Apply an explicit short-retention test policy during sustained traffic.
safety_invariants: Only eligible historical state is removed.
Live obligations remain recoverable.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Retention of live dependencies

safety_invariants: Required child results remain available until dependency/retention policy permits removal.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Transactional enqueue commit
cases.workload: Commit domain data plus enqueue/staging in the declared atomic boundary.
safety_invariants: Committed domain obligations have their expected durable job/outbox representation.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Transactional enqueue rollback
cases.workload: Roll back the same domain/job transaction and reconnect.
safety_invariants: Rolled-back obligations do not appear as committed jobs/effects.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Outbox relay crash
cases.workload: Crash relay workers after enqueue and around acknowledgement.
safety_invariants: Committed obligations eventually relay; logical duplicate handling follows the declared contract.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Non-idempotent external sink
cases.workload: Crash after external effect commit and before durable engine completion.
safety_invariants: Duplicate applications are recorded and not incorrectly classified as exactly-once behavior.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Idempotent external sink
cases.workload: Use a stable business key against the independently durable sink while injecting failures.
safety_invariants: Each intended logical effect applies once under the sink contract.
Repeated request attempts are not hidden.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Fixed CPU work
cases.workload: Perform a specified amount of deterministic CPU work per root; verify checksum.
safety_invariants: Output checksums match the independent computation.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

safety_invariants: Expected logical outputs and retry policy hold.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

safety_invariants: Each cohort obeys its own contract; aggregate success cannot hide one failed class.
cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Payload sweep

cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.

cases.name: Supported schema upgrade
cases.workload: Apply a specifically declared supported predecessor-to-current migration fixture.
safety_invariants: Live state and supported old/new worker behavior remain valid across that migration.
cases.applicability: Conditional on a published supported predecessor pair. No such pair is NOT_APPLICABLE with a documented reason; a missing fixture for a claimed supported pair is INCONCLUSIVE.

cases.name: Mixed-workload soak
cases.workload: Sustain the frozen workload mix at a validated sub-saturation rate with production-like maintenance.

cases.applicability: Required when declared provider/engine contract supports the topology; missing implementation or local capability is inconclusive, not a pass.
